info.title: Evento API
info.description:
Drogon port of the Evento Django API. Responses keep the Django shapes. Paths end with a slash.

WebSockets: `wss://<host>/ws/notifications/?access_token=<access>` sends `{"detail": "Notification Message", "message": "..."}` and closes with code 4401 when the device is logged out. `wss://<host>/ws/home/?access_token=<access>` sends a greeting.

Host.description: Empty object if the host's account was deleted

device_id.description: Only in login, Google sign-in and refresh responses

fields.description: Send every field with the file to upload_url

AuthSession.description: Login, Google sign-in and refresh responses. data.device_id identifies the session; send it with logout.

access.description: Access JWT. Send as `Authorization: Bearer <access>`. Only the newest access token of a session is accepted.

refresh.description: Refresh JWT. Single use: each refresh returns a new one and the old one stops working.

access_expiry.description: When `access` expires (UTC, the token's exp claim)

refresh_expiry.description: When `refresh` expires (UTC, the token's exp claim). Each refresh issues a token with a full new lifetime.

401.description: Not logged in, or the token is no longer valid

post.summary: Create an account (welcome email is sent in the background)
Log in. Starts a device session (User-Agent and X-Forwarded-For are recorded)

401.description: Wrong email or password (same response for an unknown email)

429.description: More than 5 attempts for this email in 15 minutes. The Retry-After header gives the seconds to wait.

post.summary: New access + refresh tokens for the same device session. The refresh token is single use.

refresh.description: The refresh token from login, Google sign-in or the last refresh

device_id.description: Accepted for compatibility and ignored; the session comes from the refresh token

200.description: Refreshed. The old refresh token and the old access token stop working.

401.description: Invalid, expired or already used refresh token, or the device was logged out

429.description: More than 10 refreshes for this user in a minute. The Retry-After header gives the seconds to wait.

post.summary: Sign in with a Google ID token (201 when the account is new). The Google email must be verified; an existing account with the same email is signed in.

401.description: The ID token was issued for a different Google client ID

422.description: Validation failed, or the ID token is invalid, expired, not from Google, or its email is not verified (field access_token)

429.description: Too many sign-ups across all users in the last minute. The Retry-After header gives the seconds to wait.

post.summary: End the device session of this refresh token. If device_id is another session of the same user, that session ends too.

refresh_token.description: A refresh token for the session
